_readme: SporeRush live promo codes. Host this file (e.g. GitHub Pages) and set REMOTE_PROMO_CODES_URL in src/config/promoCodes.ts. Entries are merged over the codes bundled in the app by code (case-insensitive): add new codes, set active:false to disable one, change rewards, or add expiresAt (ISO date). Reward keys: gems, coins, minerals, spores, biomass, lootCardDays, apexPulls, gear {set: beetle|plague|starforged, slot: weapon|helm|armor|core, rarity: 0-3}. publicInCodex:true shows a code in-game — keep it on SPORERUSH only. This file is PUBLIC: only list codes you are happy for anyone to read (bundled secret codes don't need to be repeated here).

codes.description: Official launch welcome pack — welcome to SporeRush, Commander!
